unit_text: Most of today was me arguing with my own design memo.
I still think the caching layer is the wrong fix, even though I wrote the first proposal for it.
I compared the latency graph with yesterday's trace, circled the spike near authentication, and added a note that the queue only looks healthy because the retries are hidden.
During code review with Priya I said the benchmark was misleading.
I wasn't calm when I said it.
Later I reopened the benchmark report, stared at the throughput table, and didn't send the follow-up message.
